comment: Where each page of the app lives when the deployment has moved its UI to its own host (FLOW_UI_ORIGIN, docs/deployment.md). tools/gen-route-homes.mjs writes the Caddy matcher from this file, and frontend/src/lib/page-homes.ts decides the same way from it; tools/__tests__/route-homes.test.mjs fails when a route in router.tsx is placed nowhere. moved: only these move (an exact page also with its trailing slash; a prefix as written); anything else stays where it is asked. kept: the host the API keeps answers these (OAuth, sign-in, published pages). keptOnly: kept pages whose one home is the kept host, so the Flow host sends them back. files: the extensions that are always files, never pages, so never moved.
